name: [Mode Traits] Fistborn
desc:
"A battle is won by him who is most resolved to win it."

Fistborn is a PvP-oriented game where players are capable of training to become stronger. Choose a style to master, or learn various skills to your liking and show off your fighting prowess.

Make sure to like and favorite the game to show some support!

The controls and game information can be found in the Guide tab at the very start.
Keybinds can be changed as you prefer in the settings menu under controls.

PC Controls:
E - Interact
W + W - Run
Q - Dash
R - Combat/Fists
M1 - Light Punch
M2 - Heavy Punch
F - Block & Dodge
B - Carry 
V - Mount/Grip
T - Mode
P - Map Markers (Locations)

Controller Controls:
L1+R1 - Inventory
R1+R2 - Mode
L2 - Block
L3 - Run
R2 - M1
Y - M2
B - Dash
A - Jump
X - Carry
L1+X - 1
L1+Y - 2
L1+B - 3
R1+X - 4
R1+Y - 5
R1+B - 6
DPadUp - Mount/Grip
DPadDown - Menu
DPadLeft - Shift Lock
DPadRight - Combat
